screens.name: Home — settled, transition and omen fixture
screens.evidence: Sheet 08 shows dominant illustrated orbs, an explicit touch instruction and both unavailable and synthetic omen states, supported by supplied Home layout checks.
findings: Give the unavailable omen a clearer next opportunity to recover while preserving its quiet visual priority.

screens.name: Approach — settled and transition
screens.evidence: Sheet 01 preserves orb and status placement between captures, while supplied evidence reports automatic advancement after 650ms and immediate advancement with reduced motion.
findings: Verify that assistive technology reaches the question without announcing an obsolete intermediate status.

screens.name: Ask — settled and transition
screens.evidence: Sheets 01–02 show a labeled multiline question, secondary voice action and distinct submission button with consistent transition structure.
findings: Replace user-facing prediction-engine terminology with a plain explanation of how submitted information is used.

screens.name: Ask — 200% text
screens.evidence: Sheet 01 shows the enlarged question and stacked actions fitting the capture, with supplied form checks reporting preserved context and visible submission.
findings: Confirm question editing and submission remain reachable with an actual phone keyboard and native text enlargement.

screens.name: Listening — voice unavailable and transition
screens.evidence: Sheets 08–09 show typing promoted above voice retry and a separate microphone-error notice, while supplied evidence reports transcription preservation.
findings: Place the failure explanation nearer the fallback controls so the reason for the changed task is immediately apparent.

screens.name: Planning — loading and transition
screens.evidence: Sheet 10 shows stable loading composition, a concrete activity description, an approximate wait and cancellation with no-reading-spent reassurance.
findings: Verify that status announcements and cancellation remain understandable when the wait approaches the stated minute.

screens.name: Follow-up card 1 — settled and transition
screens.evidence: Sheet 02 shows a clear first-step indicator and four separated answers, with supplied interaction evidence stating that standard answers advance immediately.
findings: Align the answers to one scale because progress made and certainty about a plan are different questions.

screens.name: Follow-up card 2 — settled and transition
screens.evidence: Sheets 02–03 show consistent question placement, step progression and roomy rows for Time, Money, Nerve and a custom response.
findings: Confirm that immediate advancement communicates the chosen answer and that Back permits an obvious correction.

screens.name: Follow-up card 3 — settled and transition
screens.evidence: Sheet 03 retains the established card layout and visibly marks the third step with three illuminated segments and text.
findings: Make the final answer's submission consequence clear before its immediate transition into prediction generation.

screens.name: Custom answer — empty, settled and transition
screens.evidence: Sheet 04 shows a retained question, Your answer label, Change action, outlined input and visibly disabled Continue button.
findings: Rename Change to Choose an option so its destination is clear before activation.

screens.name: Custom answer — empty at 200% text
screens.evidence: Sheet 03 shows a fully wrapped enlarged question, answer field and disabled submission without visible horizontal overflow.
findings: Explain that entering an answer enables Continue instead of relying entirely on the muted button state.

screens.name: Custom answer — populated at 200% text
screens.evidence: Sheet 05 shows readable entered text and an enabled multiline Reveal my prediction button, supported by supplied text-preservation checks.
findings: Verify native focus order proceeds from the retained question through the answer to the reveal action.

screens.name: Custom answer — synthetic keyboard-constrained viewport
screens.evidence: Sheet 05 exposes the entered answer and full submission button but does not show the question in the cropped viewport, while supplied checks report retained context.
findings: Verify on a physical keyboard viewport that users can recover the question context without losing their input or submit control.

screens.name: Research — loading and transition
screens.evidence: Sheet 10 maintains the planning composition while changing its activity text to gathering current context and forming the prediction.
findings: Verify the changed phase is announced once and remains distinct from the preceding planning wait.

screens.name: Plan error — settled and transition
screens.evidence: Sheets 05–06 show a recognizable failure state, no-charge reassurance, primary retry and secondary question editing using explicitly labeled fixture text.
findings: Verify retry and editing preserve the submitted question through repeated connection failures.

screens.name: Prediction error — settled and transition
screens.evidence: Sheet 06 adds Review answers to the retry and edit recovery paths without changing the established error hierarchy.
findings: Confirm that reviewing answers after failure preserves every custom response and the unused reading.

screens.name: Sensitive plan redirect — settled and transition
screens.evidence: Sheet 12 shows an explicit refusal, support link, alternative-question action and reassurance about readings and memory, with a real redirect reported in runtime evidence.
findings: Give the support action stronger emphasis when support is the relevant next step.

screens.name: Sensitive prediction redirect — settled and transition
screens.evidence: Sheet 12 preserves the plan-redirect structure after the prediction stage and explicitly states that no reading or memory entry was created.
findings: Verify the support destination and return path on the intended phone platform.

screens.name: Reveal — settled and transition
screens.evidence: Sheet 11 shows a dominant forecast, uncertainty label, explanation disclosure, reminder date and sharing action, with visibly dimmer text during the captured entrance.
findings: Verify readability throughout the reveal fade because the supplied contrast checks exclude partly opaque text.

screens.name: Reveal — expanded explanation and transition
screens.evidence: Sheet 11 shows the explanation opening below the forecast as a dense paragraph that continues beyond the capture, using explicitly synthetic content.
findings: Break long explanations into short labeled sections so supporting context can be scanned without losing the result.

screens.name: Check-in — settled and transition
screens.evidence: Sheet 04 places Yes, Not quite and Not yet beside the saved result, while supplied runtime evidence reports persisted outcome handling.
findings: Show the recorded outcome with a persistent non-color selection indicator and an obvious correction path.

screens.name: History — empty and transition
screens.evidence: Sheet 07 shows a concise empty-state message, direct Ask the Ball action and explicit device-local storage description.
findings: Verify the empty-state action has a generous target despite its understated text-only presentation.

screens.name: History — populated and transition
screens.evidence: Sheets 06–07 distinguish date, original question, forecast and Waiting status, with history persistence reported in the supplied browser drive.
findings: Clarify that Waiting refers to an outcome check-in rather than an unfinished prediction.

screens.name: History — populated stress state
screens.evidence: Sheet 07 shows repeated rows and a partially visible next entry above the fixed navigation, with supplied checks reporting added scroll clearance.
findings: Verify the final row can be fully exposed and activated above the raised Ask orb at enlarged text sizes.

screens.name: Sky — offline samples, selected question and transition
screens.evidence: Sheet 14 labels offline sample content and marks Love with a checkmark, but Ask this too is partly cut off in both shown viewport positions.
findings: Keep the selected question's complete primary action visible above navigation or make its required scroll unmistakable.

screens.name: Circles — offline
screens.evidence: Sheet 05 discloses offline status, offers Retry and dims circle creation and friend-question controls, with disabled creation confirmed by supplied checks.
findings: Explain separately why each disabled control is unavailable so network and age restrictions are not conflated.

screens.name: You — empty memory, settings and transitions
screens.evidence: Sheets 13 and 15 show plan status, a clear memory empty state and labeled preferences, with supplied evidence reporting keyboard operation and persistence.
findings: Consolidate See plans and View plans and credits if they lead to the same destination.

screens.name: Settings — 200% text
screens.evidence: Sheet 13 shows enlarged preference labels, distinct switch states and wrapped lower actions, with wide preference targets reported in controls evidence.
findings: Verify every lower settings action can scroll clear of the fixed tab bar under native text enlargement.

screens.name: Settings — keyboard focus
screens.evidence: Sheet 13 shows a conspicuous full-row focus outline around Large text, supported by reported label, Space and Enter activation checks.
findings: Extend this visible focus treatment consistently to all text actions, tabs and answer rows.

screens.name: Plans — settled and transition
screens.evidence: Sheet 09 clearly labels simulated billing and selected yearly pricing, but the settled capture starts with a clipped decorative orb and differs vertically from the transition.
findings: Verify a predictable initial scroll position that presents the plan heading and complete purchase context together.

screens.name: Plans — 200% text
screens.evidence: Sheet 09 shows stacked yearly and monthly pricing with an enlarged two-line simulated continuation button and visible test-mode labeling.
findings: Verify the selected plan, billing total and continuation action remain understandable together with native enlarged text.

screens.name: Share — settled and transition
screens.evidence: Sheets 13–14 show a compact story preview and image, video and private-link rows, while runtime evidence proves PNG export but leaves social infrastructure and OS delivery unverified.
findings: Clearly mark unavailable sharing routes and explain whether each available action previews, downloads or opens system sharing.

screens.name: Story — settled and transition
screens.evidence: Sheets 14–15 show a complete portrait card with uncertainty wording and explicit export action, backed by reported real PNG generation and injected export-error recovery.
findings: Verify exported-card legibility at typical social viewing sizes and confirm delivery through the intended OS share route.

components.name: Hero orb
components.evidence: The sheets consistently use the illustrated orb as the hero, and supplied runtime evidence reports animation sampling and actual draw cessation under reduced motion.
findings: Verify interactive orbs have explicit accessible names while decorative instances are excluded from the reading order.

components.name: Tab bar
components.evidence: Main screens show five labeled destinations, an underlined gold active tab and a raised Ask orb, with supplied checks reporting extra content clearance.
findings: Verify complete primary actions and final list rows remain reachable above the raised center control at all supported sizes.

components.name: Wordmark and balance header
components.evidence: Headers consistently separate the title or wordmark from the reading balance, which changes from one remaining to zero after the shown result.
findings: Use a self-contained balance label such as 1 reading left today wherever its meaning is otherwise implicit.

components.name: Primary button
components.evidence: Cream-filled rounded actions remain distinctive across normal and enlarged layouts, with enabled and disabled examples and supplied browser interaction evidence.
findings: Keep disabled actions accompanied by a nearby explanation of what enables them.

components.name: Secondary action
components.evidence: Gold links and divided text rows represent retry, editing, cancellation, support and navigation with varying visual prominence.
findings: Standardize target padding and use destination-specific labels for ambiguous actions such as Change.

components.name: Answer choice
components.evidence: Sheets 02–03 show spacious separated answer rows, while supplied interaction facts state that standard selections advance immediately.
findings: Provide perceptible selection confirmation and verify an accessible correction path after immediate advancement.

components.name: Question input
components.evidence: Ask screens show a persistent field label, readable multiline entry and prominent gold outline, with successful browser form traversal reported.
findings: Differentiate the resting input border from keyboard focus without adding visual weight.

components.name: Large-text input
components.evidence: Enlarged examples preserve entered text and multiline submission, while the synthetic keyboard capture does not visibly retain the question within the shown viewport.
findings: Validate context recovery, caret visibility and submission with a physical keyboard and native text scaling.

components.name: Settings switch
components.evidence: Sheet 13 shows labeled switches with position and color differences, supported by reported 342×52px targets, persistence and keyboard activation.
findings: Verify switch names and on/off values are announced correctly by VoiceOver and TalkBack.

components.name: Omen content
components.evidence: Sheet 08 shows a restrained labeled omen area with explicit unavailability and a separate synthetic populated fixture.
findings: Give the unavailable state a recovery opportunity appropriate to its actual refresh behavior.

components.name: Sky star and selected question
components.evidence: Sheet 14 pairs labeled stars with a selected-topic checkmark and corresponding sample question below.
findings: Verify generous star targets and keep the selected question's complete action clear of bottom navigation.

components.name: Circle surface
components.evidence: Sheet 05 presents borderless circle information, explicit sharing boundaries, offline status and disabled creation.
findings: Associate each unavailable control with its specific restriction rather than relying on a shared dimmed appearance.

components.name: History row
components.evidence: Sheets 06–07 separate the date, original question, prediction and status with typography and quiet dividers.
findings: Replace the ambiguous Waiting status with wording that explicitly refers to checking the outcome.

components.name: Plan option
components.evidence: Sheet 09 shows a checkmarked yearly selection, annual total, monthly equivalent and a stacked enlarged layout with explicit test-mode boundaries.
findings: Verify that plan selection and its billing amount are announced together as one accessible option.

components.name: Share preview
components.evidence: Sheets 13–15 show a consistent portrait composition whose qualification text becomes very small in the compact preview.
findings: Provide a readable preview expansion or adjacent text equivalent for the forecast and its uncertainty wording.

components.name: Notice and recovery
components.evidence: Error, offline and microphone states visibly explain limitations and offer recovery, with supplied runtime evidence covering connection recovery and an injected export failure.
findings: Verify announcements and focus placement make recovery notices discoverable without requiring users to scan the entire screen.

components.name: Typography
components.evidence: The sheets maintain distinct serif headings, script atmosphere and sans-serif utility text, with enlarged examples and bounded rendered-background contrast sampling supplied.
findings: Increase the readability of compact metadata and validate text during fades as well as at settled opacity.

components.name: Atmospheric background
components.evidence: Dark mist and gold illumination remain coherent across the sheets, with supplied browser evidence reporting contrast samples, motion performance and reduced-motion cessation.
findings: Validate readability and motion comfort on physical displays across intermediate animation frames.

limitations: All scores are provisional: this evaluation uses the supplied screenshots and runtime narrative without independently executing checks or inspecting additional files.

All 17 core states and the represented error, empty, populated, expanded, custom-input, offline, enlarged, focused and loading variants are covered; corresponding transitions are grouped with their settled screens.

For each item, calculate A from hierarchy, typography and surfaces, F from clarity, feedback and accessibility, and overall as 0.4A + 0.6F rounded to one decimal, excluding genuinely inapplicable null dimensions.
Static transition pairs support composition comparisons but cannot prove temporal continuity, absence of layout shifts or perceivable press feedback.
The supplied browser checks support browser behavior only; physical iPhone Safari, native text enlargement, keyboard safe areas, VoiceOver/TalkBack, microphone hardware and haptics remain unverified.
Reported contrast checks exclude clipped or partly opaque text and do not establish contrast in every animation frame or native rendering.
Synthetic fixture wording was not treated as a production-copy defect or evidence of predictive accuracy; no model-quality conclusion is supported.
Real payments, configured social infrastructure and OS share delivery remain unverified; simulated billing, sample stars and disabled offline circle creation are visibly disclosed.
Screenshots do not establish that clipped Sky actions or lower content are unreachable, so no inaccessible-control hard gate is asserted from cropping alone.
The authorized A>=9 and F>=9 threshold is not met; the evidence does not permit premium or exemplary certification.
topFixes: Verify and improve Sky action visibility above the fixed navigation and raised Ask orb.
Preserve recoverable question context with a physical keyboard at 200% text and test complete submission on-device.
Clarify immediate-answer consequences, Change destinations and Waiting outcome status.
Make long explanations easier to scan and compact preview qualifications readable.
Distinguish available share routes from unavailable services and verify actual delivery.
Complete physical-device and assistive-technology checks, including transition contrast, focus, announcements and reduced motion.
